blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the moves that make you flip the symbol.
blocks.display: Select all the moves that make you flip the symbol.

blocks.text: Divide both sides by negative four. Yes: dividing by a negative number flips the symbol.
Multiply both sides by negative one. Yes: multiplying by a negative number flips the symbol.
Add negative three to both sides. No: adding never flips the symbol, even when the number is negative.
Divide both sides by five. No: five is positive, so the symbol stays.
Subtract six from both sides. No: subtracting never flips the symbol.
Dividing by negative four and multiplying by negative one flip the symbol. Adding, subtracting, or dividing by a positive number never does.
